newsitem.title: UK: Scottish Blackface prices down at UK wool auction.
newsitem.headline: Scottish Blackface prices down at UK wool auction.

text.p: At the first 1997 auction of Scottish raw wool, Blackface and Crossbred descriptions lost two and a half percent of their value, the British Wool Marketing Board reported on Wednesday.
Halfbreds sold in buyers favour while sellers benefitted from movements in Cheviot prices, the report said.
The total offering of 2,189,363 kilos saw steady competition resulting in a clearance rate of over seventy percent.
Further sale details will be available on Thursday.
